signs.name: No time charge
signs.definition: Indicates a motorway section that is not subject to a time charge. The sign may also be used to indicate a section of the motorway which, unlike the preceding section, is not subject to a time charge.

signs.name: With time charge
signs.definition: Indicates a section of road whose use is subject to a time charge. The sign may also be used to indicate a section of motorway which, unlike the preceding section, is subject to a time charge.

signs.name: Without toll
signs.definition: Indicates a section of motorway that is not subject to tolls. The sign can also be used to indicate a section of the road which, unlike the previous section, is not subject to tolls.

signs.name: With toll
signs.definition: Indicates the section of road whose use is subject to tolls. The sign can also be used to indicate a section of motorway whose use is subject to tolls, unlike the previous section.

signs.name: No time charge and no toll
signs.definition: Indicates a section of motorway that is not subject to time or toll charges. The sign may also be used to indicate a section of the road which, unlike the preceding section, is not subject to a time or toll charge.

signs.name: With time charge and toll
signs.definition: indicates a section of road whose use is subject to time and toll charges. The sign may also be used to indicate a section of motorway which, unlike the preceding section, is subject to time and toll charges.

signs.name: Cyclists riding in the opposite direction
signs.definition: The sign, if placed under a "One-way traffic" sign, informs drivers that cyclists are allowed to ride in the opposite direction. The driver must adapt his behaviour to this fact, in particular his obligation not to endanger other road users (cyclists).

signs.name: Cyclists allowed in the opposite direction
signs.definition: The sign, if placed under a "No entry for all vehicles" sign, permits cyclists to enter the one-way road in the given direction.

signs.name: Permitted direction of travel for cyclists
signs.definition: The sign indicates the possible direction of travel for cyclists using the corresponding directional arrows.

signs.name: Transit
signs.definition: The sign restricts the validity of the marking to goods vehicles for which the use of the section so marked is not necessary to reach the place of loading, unloading, maintenance or repair of the vehicle, the registered office, place of business or usual residence of the haulier or driver.

signs.name: Tunnel category
signs.definition: The sign supplements the main sign "No entry of vehicles carrying dangerous goods" and informs about the relevant tunnel category in the following road section. The indication of the category shall be given in the range of letters 'B' to 'E' according to UNECE ADR regulation ).

signs.name: Distance to the next petrol station
signs.definition: The sign usually supplements the main sign "Signal before rest area" and informs about the distance to the service station following the service station located at the marked rest area.

signs.name: Insufficient clearance above the roadway
signs.definition: The sign, in combination with the "Other Hazard" sign, warns of the restriction of the road profile.
